detail.longDescription: Every few months, the websites we’ve familiarized ourselves with get overhauled without our input. One day YouTube shorts cross everyone’s feed, the next day there’s an AI ready to summarize every post. In response, I made a Chrome extension that freezes website design at a time in which it felt more functional. It’s free, local, open-source, non-intrusive, and tailor-made for 170+ of the most popular websites. Recommend websites to add or report issues here: https://github.com/PigeonFlare/net19/issues
